name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal
task: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a conditional 'if you pick up the key, you must also open the door', where opening the door is a consequent ('also'), not a step ordered after the key. RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) hard captures this exactly, holds vacuously when the key is never picked up, and requires nothing unconditionally, so the empty FINAL_STATES with the rule-only warning is valid. Propositions are grounded and the priority is hard, matching 'must' with no preference cue.

texts: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.
